dataRecovery.heroTitle: What looks permanently deleted usually isn't.
dataRecovery.heroDesc: When a drive gets formatted or a partition vanishes, the files don't disappear — the file system just forgets where they are. NexData reads the raw sectors directly, reconstructs what's still there, and lets you pull it back. Scan for free. Preview everything. Recover what matters.
dataRecovery.howTitle: How NexData finds what other tools miss
dataRecovery.howSubtitle: Most recovery tools rely on the file system. When that's gone — formatted, corrupted, or just missing — they have nothing to work with. NexData doesn't need it.
dataRecovery.howCard1Desc: Instead of asking the file system what's on the disk, NexData reads the physical sectors directly. It recognizes file types by their binary headers — JPEG, MP4, PDF, DOCX — and reconstructs them regardless of what the partition table says. This is how recovery works on drives that won't even mount.
dataRecovery.howCard2Desc: Video files recovered from fragmented drives are almost always unplayable — the container headers get mangled during the recovery process. NexData's repair module takes a working reference clip from the same camera and uses it to rebuild corrupted headers, making the footage watchable again.
dataRecovery.howCard3Desc: BitLocker, FileVault, APFS encryption — these aren't roadblocks as long as you have the recovery key. NexData can unlock the volume and run a full sector scan underneath the encryption layer, recovering files that were deleted before the drive was encrypted.
dataRecovery.howCard4Desc: NexData doesn't call home. Ever. The scan results, file previews, and recovered files stay entirely on your machine. Nothing is transmitted, logged, or reported. If you're recovering sensitive documents — legal files, medical records, personal photos — this is the baseline you should expect.
dataRecovery.pricingSubtitle: Scan any drive and preview every recoverable file for free. Upgrade only when you need to actually pull files off the disk.
dataRecovery.freeFeature2: Preview every recoverable file and video
dataRecovery.freeInstallNote: Install free. Scan your drive. Verify the files are intact before you spend anything.
dataRecovery.proDeliveryNote: License key delivered instantly via email. 10-day refund policy.
dataRecovery.installDesc: We're an indie developer, so the initial builds aren't signed with Apple or Microsoft certificates yet. Your OS will show a standard security prompt — here's how to get past it:
dataRecovery.installMacDesc: Drag the app to Applications. Open Terminal. Paste this and press Enter: xattr -cr ... Double-click the app to launch it.
dataRecovery.installWinDesc: Run the downloaded .exe file. If you see a blue Windows protected your PC prompt — click More info, then Run anyway.
dataRecovery.cantSubtitle: No recovery tool can work miracles. Here's what to know upfront.
dataRecovery.cantCard1Desc: Once new data is written to the same physical sectors, the original content is destroyed at the hardware level. No software — ours included — can undo that. This is why you should stop writing to the drive the moment you realize files are missing.
dataRecovery.cantCard2Desc: If a drive has suffered mechanical failure — head crash, water damage, burned circuitry — software can't access the platters or chips. That requires a cleanroom and professional data recovery, which is a different service entirely.
dataRecovery.cantCard3Desc: Modern SSDs with TRIM enabled will erase deleted blocks in the background, usually within minutes. Once the controller zeroes a block, that data is physically gone. TRIM is on by default for most SSDs, which is why HDD recovery success rates are typically higher.
dataRecovery.cantCard4Desc: If a drive was encrypted with BitLocker, FileVault, or APFS encryption and you've lost the password and recovery key, the data can't be decrypted. No software can brute-force modern encryption in any reasonable timeframe.
dataRecovery.cantNote: These scenarios fall outside our refund policy. We recommend scanning with the free version first to confirm your files are actually recoverable.
dataRecovery.ctaTitle: Scan first. See what's there. Decide later.
dataRecovery.ctaDesc: The free version does a full scan and lets you preview every recoverable file — so you know exactly what you're getting before you pay.

pdfToolkit.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about NexPDF offline editing.
pdfToolkit.faqQ1: How does local PDF editing work?
pdfToolkit.faqA1: It uses WebAssembly and client-side JavaScript PDF manipulation libraries to compile, edit, sign, merge, and split files inside your browser. No files are ever sent to an external server.
pdfToolkit.faqQ2: Are my PDF documents secure with NexPDF?
pdfToolkit.faqA2: Yes, entirely secure. Because all tools execute locally inside your browser client sandbox, sensitive files like contracts, bank statements, or tax documents never leave your machine.
pdfToolkit.faqA3: Yes. NexPDF is built as a Progressive Web App (PWA). Once you visit the site, the tools are cached locally and work without an active internet connection.
pdfToolkit.faqQ4: Are there limits or watermarks on output files?
pdfToolkit.faqA4: No. NexPDF does not add watermarks, impose file size caps, or enforce daily usage limits. You get professional PDF editing completely free.
pdfToolkit.ctaDesc: Open the editor, drop in a file, and get to work. No sign-up, no trial countdown.

text-to-pdf.p: You have meeting notes, server logs, or a code snippet that needs to go out as a PDF. Paste the text in, check the preview, and download a cleanly formatted document. Line breaks and spacing are preserved exactly.
features: Clean typography with consistent formatting
Preserves line breaks, indentation, and spacing
Instant conversion with live preview
No data leaves your browser

steps.desc: Configure paper margins and check typography in the preview window.

steps.title: Export PDF
steps.desc: Click "Convert to PDF" to save the completed document.

seoPage.localPrivateDesc: This tool processes your files directly in your browser — nothing gets uploaded to a server. When you're working with {tool}, the document stays on your machine from start to finish.
seoPage.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about {tool}.
seoPage.readyDesc: Drop your file in the workspace at the top of the page. No registration required.
seoPage.faqA1: {steps} All of this is done on your machine.
seoPage.faqQ2: Are my PDF files safe during this process?
seoPage.faqA2: Absolutely. Because NexPDF runs entirely client-side using WebAssembly, the document is never uploaded to any external server. Your sensitive data is kept 100% private.
seoPage.faqQ3: Is there a file size limit for {tool}?
seoPage.faqA3: No, there are no artificial file size caps. The only physical limit is your device's available browser memory, which easily handles large documents.
seoPage.faqA4: Yes, NexPDF is cached inside your browser after the first load. You can disconnect your internet and continue to use the tool completely offline.
